## Staging Environment Setup Complete

### Completed

**Docker Configuration:**
- ✅ Backend Dockerfile (`Dockerfile.backend`) - FastAPI with Python 3.11
- ✅ Frontend Dockerfile (`Dockerfile.frontend`) - React/Vite with nginx
- ✅ Docker Compose (`docker-compose.staging.yml`) - Full stack orchestration
- ✅ Database init script (`database/init.sql`) - Schema initialization

**Documentation:**
- ✅ [DEPLOYMENT.md](prequal-platform/DEPLOYMENT.md) - Complete deployment guide
- ✅ [README.md](README.md) - Project-level documentation

**Configuration:**
- ✅ `.env.staging.example` - Environment template (already existed)
- ✅ `.gitignore` - Proper ignores for Python/Node/Docker

### How to Deploy

```bash
cd prequal-platform
cp .env.staging.example .env
docker compose -f docker-compose.staging.yml --env-file .env up --build
```

### Services

| Service | Port | URL |
|---------|------|-----|
| Frontend | 3000 | http://localhost:3000 |
| Backend API | 8000 | http://localhost:8000/health |
| PostgreSQL | 5432 | localhost:5432 |
| Redis | 6379 | localhost:6379 |
| PGAdmin | 5050 | http://localhost:5050 |
